en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy town square with horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians, a central monument and surrounding multi‑storey buildings. Two church towers or clocktowers rise above the square. The caption at the bottom reads "Széchényi tér", and at the top right "Üdvözlet Pécsről". The reverse side bears the printed word "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" and address lines, with a blank stamp box.
